items.en: When Sem applies an import that differs from what you already have, you can choose item by item whether to keep it or take the import.
items.zh: Sem 应用导入时，与已有内容不同的部分可逐项选择保留或采用导入的内容。

items.en: On a phone, Today has a week strip on top: swipe through weeks and tap a day to see its classes, events and tasks.
items.zh: 手机上的“今天”顶部新增周条，可以左右滑动翻看各周，点任意一天查看当天的课程、事件和待办。

items.en: On a phone, a new Courses tab shows your GPA and this term's courses; each course opens its overview, grades, files and announcements, and notifications open there.
items.zh: 手机上新增“课程”标签，可以查看 GPA 和本学期的课程；点开课程即可查看概览、成绩、文件和公告，通知也会直接打开对应页面。

items.en: In MCP clients that support forms, Semestra asks you to confirm deletions, batch changes and imports, lets you pick a course when it is unclear, and lets you settle import conflicts item by item.
items.zh: 在支持表单的 MCP 客户端中，删除、批量修改与导入前会请你确认；课程不明确时可直接选择；导入冲突可逐项决定保留或覆盖。
